name: spdf-zotero
description: Zotero 7 and 8 plugin for SPDF: import an .spdf file as an item with its CSL metadata, attach SPDF files, and copy a short citation with the exact printed folio plus its anchor URI.
author: José Luis Saorín Ferrer <jl@joseluissaorin.com> (https://joseluissaorin.com)

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && vitest run
